probe: G2 wiki contribution sources join the publication-level derived permission gate (wiki-publication-gate-deps-I071 glue item G2)

what_shipped.producer_stamping: openviking/wiki/merge.py: _plan_pages keeps the full contributor set when replayed variants collapse onto one page URI (prior['contributors'] grows, sorted); publish passes entries through; _index_pages stamps source_snapshot['wiki_contributors'] = sorted(page.get('contributors', [])) right after text_sha256 so the list travels inside _source_snapshot -> registry.begin(source_ref=...) -> sources.reference JSON -> published manifest item['content']
what_shipped.registry_validation: openviking/indexing/publication.py begin() validates the new key: wiki_contributors must be a list of viking://resources/ URIs (ValueError otherwise); absence keeps existing behavior, no migration surface
what_shipped.gate_extraction: openviking/indexing/derived_access.py denied_derived_uris now extracts both image_context_epochs (epoch dict) and wiki_contributors (URI list) into one combined {derived_uri: [sources]} map; per-URI keys merge without dropping either side; the ACL-intersection deny computation (namespace roots, resolve_many read permission, tombstone prefix) runs over all sources of both kinds, and the disabled-ACL fallback denies the full combined set

mechanism: Published wiki pages are derived content: their indexed chunks stay visible only while every extraction source of that page still grants READ to the querier. The manifest dependency key flows producer (merge stamp) -> begin validation -> manifest content -> query-time intersection in denied_derived_uris, which already backs the vector-search must_not filter, the BM25 dual gate and the FS read-channel recheck added in I057.

tests.new_suite: tests/enterprise_kb/test_derived_image_access.py — 7 passed (4 pre-existing + 3 new): contributor losing READ hides the page; tombstoning any contributor or disabling ACLs hides it even for an otherwise-authorized group member; a published page whose snapshot carries no wiki_contributors key stays visible to everyone (absence = not derived)
tests.regressions: test_wiki_candidate_merge 38 passed (full publish/preflight chain over real ACL/SQLite/disk); test_content_publication 9 passed

truthful_boundaries: The stamp is written at publish time from merge provenance; a wiki page reindexed later through vectorize_file regenerates its snapshot from disk without the contributor list — reindex path recovery is out of G2 scope and left to the unified registry lifecycle (same boundary as before).
Contributors list only extraction sources (provenance source_uri), not relation targets; relation revocation semantics continue to live in schema-level graph checks.
The begin() check validates URI shape only; contributors need not exist in any namespace at stamp time — the gate excludes only what resolve_many/tombstones actually observe at query time.
